***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Lee Jae Myung]] says that all but two Korean vessels have successfully transited through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] after previously being stranded in the [[waterway]] amidst the war. [https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/20260630/lee-says-all-but-2-korean-vessels-have-left-strait-of-hormuz (''The Korea Times'')] [https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10792814 (''Korea Herald'')]
****[[Thailand]]’s [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Thailand)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] says that 10 out of 11 ships have successfully departed the [[Strait of Hormuz]] after previously being stranded since the war started on February 28. Additionally, the ministry says that the only ship remaining in the [[waterway]] is the Hatthaya Naree, which is expected to depart the region once cargo is loaded on the ship. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/thailand-says-10-stranded-vessels-leave-strait-hormuz (Middle East Eye)]

**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] launch a major [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Moscow Oblast]], [[Russia]], striking the [[Russian Satellite Communications Company|Dubna Space Communications Center]] to the north of [[Moscow]].
